messages:
nina: Heads up: new model 'siren-17b' int4 onboard is showing sporadic OOMs during high-concurrency tests on 48GB hosts. Repro'd on canary earlier.
ralph: saw the same. OOMs happen when many long-gen requests pile up (max_new_tokens >= 800). Allocator logs show many small free ranges.
tara: Attached perf note: when kv_prefetch=true combined with sustained micro-batching, fragmentation climbs fast. p95 memory jumps before oom.
nina: Quick repro I ran: curl against canary with 12 parallel streams, mix of max_new_tokens 256/1024. Node ran out after ~90s.
ralph: snippet from runtime log: "AllocationError: unable to find contiguous slab 1.9GiB (largest free run 1.1GiB)". this is classic fragmentation, not total-mem shortage.
tara: Short-term mitigations to canary: 1) reduce default max_new_tokens to 512, 2) cap max_batch_size=4, 3) reduce batch_token_budget to 900, 4) enable slot_compact small reserve (slot_reserve=0.04).
nina: Proposed route patch (canary):
---
model: siren-17b
quant: int4
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 512
  max_batch_size: 4
  batch_tokens: 900
heuristics:
  kv_prefetch: true
  kv_trim_threshold: 0.8
  soft_evict: true
  slot_reserve: 0.04
fallbacks:
  memory_pressure_fallback: siren-17b-8k (reduced context)
---
ralph: +1. Also suggest adding a short burst-throttle in front-end (100ms token-spread jitter) to avoid synchronized spikes.
tara: I'll add a compaction run as part of the canary smoke: simulate 20 concurrent clients with mixed tokens, then invoke manual compaction and verify slab fragmentation ratio drops.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: siren-17b route patch -> rack-3, 2024-05-10T03:00:00Z for 20m. Notifying eng-ml and eng-infra.
sam: I'll monitor allocator fragmentation, OOM count, p95 latency and error-rate in the window. If OOMs < 1/hr and fragmentation ratio < 0.25, we can roll to wider canary.
nina: I'll open PR with route change + throttling hook and add the smoke test script. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
